title: Freedomchat
description: FreedomChat adds filtering to chat, the filtering is customizable from config, and so is the message you get if your message was censored!
body: Freedom Chat (Chat Filterer) is a mod that adds a filter to chat so server owners (also those who have a singleplayer world they want to filter messages on) can filter messages on their server or singleplayer world, to customize the words to filter for just type them into the config under the BANNED_WORDS list, if you want to change the message the user gets if their message was censored you can change it in config.
